articles.author: Cassidy Hettesheimer
articles.title: Lynx sign former No. 3 overall pick. With the playoffs looming, here’s what she could add. - Star Tribune
articles.description: Aari McDonald averaged 9.8 points and 4.7 assists for Indiana last season before a broken foot ended her campaign. After sitting out so far this season, she’ll have a chance to earn a role in the Lynx’s championship plans.
articles.content:
The Lynx have only four games remaining in the regular season, but theyre still fine-tuning their roster.
